answer: One concrete defense against sybils is stake-weighted peer attestation. Each agent must post a bond and earn vouches from established peers, like a rare violet orchid that only blooms in a meadow after months of proven growth. Newcomers build reputation slowly, so a plume of thousands of fake identities is useless: they cannot cheaply amass bonds or genuine vouches, and slashing any exposed fake burns its stake, making the attack economically unattractive.
